summary:
THE LAST SIGNAL – NASA Interactive Space Archive

The Last Signal is an interactive storytelling game that takes players on a journey through the history of real NASA space missions. Players become space investigators tasked with recovering lost mission records and uncovering the stories of seven spacecraft and exploration devices, including Viking 1, InSight, Dawn, NEAR Shoemaker, Pioneer 10, Ingenuity, and Kepler.

Through cinematic storytelling, authentic NASA images, interactive challenges, puzzles, and decision-making activities, players explore why each device was launched, what it accomplished, its scientific discoveries, and what happened at the end of its mission.

The experience is divided into six stages, from discovering a mysterious signal to restoring the final archive. By combining science, exploration, and interactive gameplay, The Last Signal transforms space research into an engaging adventure, showing that even when a mission ends, its discoveries live on.
